description: This file contains code for training and evaluating a sequence classification model using PyTorch, Hugging Face datasets and transformers, with support for TorchDynamo backends and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: data_processing
methods.description: Loads dataset, tokenizes, and prepares DataLoaders for training and evaluation.

methods.name: training_iter_fn
methods.description: Performs a training step: forward pass, loss computation, backward pass, and optimizer step.

methods.name: model_training_evaluation
methods.description: Trains and optionally evaluates the model over multiple epochs, supports different backends.

methods.name: check_loss
methods.description: Checks if the recent loss is within acceptable bounds compared to reference loss.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for training configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating data loading, model training, evaluation, and timing.
